props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that virtualization and hypervisor trust requirements are satisfied.

props.name: attack-tactic

metadata.remarks: Secure Virtualization is a composite pattern asserting that physical host trust, virtualization isolation, and hypervisor integrity requirements are all satisfied. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for use in solution patterns and system security and privacy plans.
